description: Search Ceneo.pl (Poland's price-comparison engine) by phrase. Returns each product's lowest price and how many shops offer it, plus its Ceneo product id (use it with ceneo_product_offers). Fetched live from Ceneo.pl (a few seconds via direct fetch; up to ~20s when routed through an unblocker backend). Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, query, count, products: [...], note? } — the list key is `products`, and there are no per-shop offers here (call ceneo_product_offers with a product `id` for those). Each product: { id, name, url, lowestPrice, currency, shopCount, image }; `lowestPrice` is the formatted string Ceneo renders, not a number. A genuine no-match answers count: 0 with a `note` saying what to try instead — that is a successful result, not an error.
name: ceneo_search
title: Search Ceneo products
